vectors.name: reply_error
wire: No valid IK solution exists for the target pose. Target [520.0, 0.0, 130.0] mm.
Verify the target lies inside the workspace, or try a different orientation.

vectors.name: reply_complete_error
wire: Measured position did not settle on target within the window (max residual 0.02 rad).
Command completed with error under the strict policy.
Check for mechanical obstruction, or relax the completion policy.

vectors.name: reply_complete_cancelled
wire: The command was cancelled by stop before it finished.
The motion did not run to completion.
Re-issue the command if the motion is still wanted.

vectors.name: reply_error_near_singularity
wire: The planned path passes near a singular configuration (condition 2400, sigma_min 0.00007).
Warning only; motion continues with degraded cartesian accuracy.
Re-route the segment away from the singular pose if precision matters.

vectors.name: reply_error_stream_fault
wire: The streaming rate limiter kept failing for a sustained interval.
Streaming stopped; controller DISABLED; error latched.
Check the daemon log for the limiter failure, then send reset.

vectors.name: response_error_active
wire: Release the e-stop, then send reset.
